title: gh · team workflow
subtitle: GitHub CLI for a draft-PR, review-first team. <base> is your integration branch.

columns.title: Set up
rows: Sign in once; pick SSH for git
Which account and scopes are active
Clone with the remote set up
Open this repo in the browser

columns.title: Start work
rows: Update it, without a merge commit
One branch per ticket, named for it

columns.title: Commit and push
rows: Run the gates before every commit
Hooks run; fix what they flag
Push the branch and track it

columns.title: Find your work
rows: Your PRs, and reviews waiting on you
Open a PR in the browser

columns.title: Rules
rules: - Push or commit straight to <base> or main
- Open a PR as ready, or mark your own PR ready
- Merge someone else's PR for them
- Skip hooks with --no-verify, or commit a secret
+ Tests pass locally before the PR exists
+ Report failures with the real error message

columns.title: Open a draft PR
rows: Draft PR, title and body from your commits
Or write the title and body yourself
columns.note: Add -r <reviewer> to ask for a review. The body says why, what changed, and how it was tested.

columns.title: Check CI
rows: Follow checks; stop at the first failure
Logs of the failed steps only

columns.title: Ready and merge
columns.note_above: Done by a person, after review.

columns.title: When gh misbehaves
rows: Edit a PR's body when gh pr edit fails
columns.note: In gh api paths, gh fills in {owner} and {repo} from the current repo.
